context: Two cafe friends recap a tense first-meeting morning
purpose: Teach: さておき/おもう/あがる/はずし/内心/さわやか/ネガティブ/交わし

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: さっきの朝、さわやかな顔して接客してたけど、内心ドキドキだったでしょ？
lines.en: You looked all fresh-faced serving customers this morning, but inside you were nervous, right?
lines.style: Teasing, knowing tone with a playful smirk between coworkers.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: バレた…レジで目が合った瞬間、血圧があがるかと思ったよ。
lines.en: Busted... the moment our eyes met at the register, I thought my blood pressure would spike.
lines.style: Embarrassed confession, dropping voice slightly, hands covering cheeks.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 二言三言交わしただけなのに、注文聞くときピントはずしてたよね。
lines.en: You only exchanged a few words with him, but you totally missed the mark when taking his order.
lines.style: Amused observation, gently teasing while wiping down the counter.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: やめてよ、思い出すだけで本当に恥ずかしいっておもう…。
lines.en: Stop it, just remembering it I genuinely feel embarrassed...
lines.style: Whining playfully, burying face in hands with dramatic exaggeration.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: でもさ、ネガティブに考えすぎないで。彼、ちゃんと笑顔返してたじゃん。
lines.en: But hey, don't think about it too negatively. He smiled back at you, you know.
lines.style: Supportive shift, warmer tone, leaning in like a trusted friend.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ほんと？冗談はさておき、明日もシフト一緒だよね…どうしよう。
lines.en: Really? All jokes aside, we're on the same shift tomorrow too, right? What do I do.
lines.style: Shifting from hopeful to panicked, gripping apron nervously with wide eyes.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 落ち着いて。明日もさわやかな笑顔で挨拶すれば、自然と距離は縮まるよ。
lines.en: Calm down. If you greet him with a fresh smile again tomorrow, the distance will close naturally.
lines.style: Reassuring mentor voice, soft and steady, patting friend's shoulder.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: うん…緊張であがると思うけど、頑張ってみる。アオイがいてくれて助かる。
lines.en: Yeah... I'll probably freeze up from nerves, but I'll try. I'm so glad you're here with me.
lines.style: Quiet gratitude, small smile returning, voice softening with sincerity.
